# CLI golden cases: "<name> <arguments as shell words>", run in
# testdata/data as "fpgrowth <arguments>" by reference/harness/cli/gen.sh
# (C reference) and by TestGolden (Go). "<file" reads stdin from a file
# (default: empty stdin), ">&-" closes stdout. Cases whose Go output
# differs by design are listed in deviations.txt.

# usage and help
usage
help -!
help-late -s10 -! -tq

# docs/upstream/cli-io.md §9.1
